info.title: ReAI API
info.description:
REST API for getting and updating data programmatically.

## Authentication

* Send your API token in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`
* Tenant-scoped requests with user access tokens must send the tenant header: `X-Tenant-Id: <tenant-id>`
* Use `GET /api/me` to discover the authenticated user and available tenants
* Meta endpoints such as `GET /api/me` and `POST /api/tenants` can be used without a tenant header

post.summary: Validate the tax return for a fiscal year
post.description: Validates the current tax-return draft against Skatteetaten and returns the errors (avvik) — without creating a submission, an Altinn instance, or filing anything. Re-fetches the Skatteetaten source and runs the exact validator the submit flow uses, so it predicts a real submit for ENK/AS/NUF. Participant-taxed companies (ANS/DA, SDF) may differ: submit applies a post-calculation correction that this endpoint does not. Requires an active ID-porten session (validation is authorized by the taxpayer's ID-porten token); check the read endpoint's sources.idPortenConnected first. When GET reports request-scoped property-inventory or source-data confirmations, send the corresponding booleans and exact fingerprints in the optional request body.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Fiscal year of the tax return (e.g. 2025).

post.summary: File the tax return for a fiscal year
post.description: Files the tax return with Skatteetaten (via Altinn) — a legal submission. Validates first: if the return has errors it is NOT filed and the errors are returned (422). When GET reports request-scoped property-inventory or source-data confirmations, send the corresponding booleans and exact fingerprints in the optional request body. A refreshed source mismatch returns 422 before any Altinn instance is created.

bankFeeInCurrency.description: Bank fee in the invoice currency.

detail.description: Email document type: Invoice, Reminder, or Notice of Debt Collection. This field does not contain delivery errors or bounce messages.

success.description: True when the invoice was handed over to the Peppol network on this attempt. The newest row decides whether the invoice is delivered over EHF.

error.description: Failure reason for this attempt. Null when the attempt succeeded.

selectableAccountNumber.description: Combined parent account number and general sub-account id separated by `/`, matching the web account selector display value. Public API write requests that model subsidiary ledgers separately should use `accountNumber` and `id` instead.

number.description: Selectable account number. For subsidiary ledger entries this contains the parent account number and subsidiary id separated by `/`, matching the web combobox value.

closed.description: Whether the monthly reconciliation is closed and the bank subledger is locked for the month.

AnnualAccountsSubmissionRes.description: Latest stored annual-accounts submission for a fiscal year.

year.description: Fiscal year of the annual accounts.

status.description: Public submission status. submitted_in_other_system takes precedence when the annual accounts were recorded as delivered outside ReAI.

deliveryMethod.description: Delivery channel used for the submission.

deliveryStatusCheckedAt.description: Time ReAI last checked Altinn for the delivery status, if applicable.

outcome.description: Result of a public API lifecycle command.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code. Use the `code` value returned by `GET /api/currencies`.

CountryCode.description: Two-letter country code supported by ReAI. Use the `code` value returned by `GET /api/countries`.

VatCode.description: VAT code. Use the `code` value returned by `GET /api/vat-codes`. Order, offer, and subscription lines accept only the codes returned by `GET /api/vat-codes?usage=customer-invoice`.

AccountNumber.description: Base chart of accounts number. Use the `number` value returned by `GET /api/chart-of-accounts` or the `accountNumber` value returned by `GET /api/chart-of-accounts/accounts`.

TenantRoleCode.description: Tenant role code. Use the `code` value returned by `GET /api/users/roles`.

AssignableTenantRoleCode.description: Assignable tenant role code. Use an `assignable=true` role returned by `GET /api/users/roles`.

AssignableTenantPermissionCode.description: Directly assignable tenant permission code. Use the `code` value returned by `GET /api/users/permissions`.

EffectiveTenantPermissionCode.description: Effective tenant permission code, including implied read permissions and self-scoped permissions granted through roles.

detail.example: status has invalid value 'bad'. Allowed values: active, disqualified.

error.example: status has invalid value 'bad'. Allowed values: active, disqualified.
